dedupe_keys.name: signals and symptoms ics attack dataset from a railway cyber range

description: This dataset comes from two industrial control system cyberattack simulations on a railway cyber range that resembles railway infrastructure. The abstract says the attack scenarios blend current attack trends with patterns from historical ICS incidents, and that the resulting evidence is collected as datasets for cyberattack analysis, capturing indicators relevant to the current threat landscape to help security systems and analysts. The preprint was submitted to arXiv on 2 July 2025 under CC BY 4.0 and appears as a chapter in Lecture Notes in Computer Science (2026). Coverage: one railway cyber range. Format and access: described in an open preprint. Licence and cost: CC BY 4.0 for the preprint; dataset terms not stated on the abstract page. Caveats: the abstract page does not say where the data are deposited, so access must be checked in the paper. It supports cascading failure and digital twin studies of cyber attacks on rail control systems. It relates to the Electra traction substation dataset and the STSRS dataset in the catalogue.
